tasks.label: Downlink: Start dev
args: if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ -s ${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh ]]; then source "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh"; fi; mkdir -p ../../target; pidfile=../../target/vscode-dev.pid; if [[ -f $pidfile ]] && kill -0 -- -$(cat "$pidfile") 2>/dev/null; then echo 'Downlink dev is already running.'; exit 0; fi; setsid bash -c 'echo $$ > ../../target/vscode-dev.pid; exec cargo tauri dev --config "$DOWNLINK_DEV_CONFIG"' & child=$!; cleanup() { trap '' TERM; if [[ -f $pidfile ]]; then kill -TERM -- -$(cat "$pidfile") 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$pidfile"; fi; }; trap cleanup EXIT; trap 'exit 0' INT TERM; wait "$child"

tasks.label: Downlink: Stop dev
args: pidfile=target/vscode-dev.pid; if [[ -f $pidfile ]]; then kill -TERM -- -$(cat "$pidfile") 2>/dev/null || true; else echo 'Downlink dev is not running.'; fi
